source: Steam Community guide: Player Personality and Media Handling Style Guide (FM24)

tiers.label: Excellent
tiers.guide_section: Personalities You Should Be Excited By
tiers.description: The best of the best — standout personalities with strong hidden attributes.

tiers.label: Good
tiers.description: Still above average, but not as strong as Excellent. Some have notable weaknesses.

tiers.label: Fair
tiers.guide_section: Not Bad, but Not Great Personalities
tiers.description: Better than average, but not especially exciting to have.

tiers.label: Mixed
tiers.description: More of a dice roll than a sure thing — one or two strong traits, with the rest left to fortune.

tiers.label: Developing
tiers.description: Have shortcomings that need mentoring. With the right group, they can improve into better personalities over time.

tiers.label: Poor
tiers.description: Very weak personalities to avoid. Especially disappointing on youth-intake players.
